              │    space             mark the project, to list several projects'     │
              │  items                                                               │
              │    a                 add a project                                   │
              │    A                 add an item to several projects                 │
              │    n                 rename the project                              │
              │    e                 edit the description in $EDITOR                 │
              │    c                 complete the project                            │
              │    x                 drop the project, saying why                    │
              │    S                 shelve the project for someday                  │
              │    M                 move the project, then j and k, Enter to drop   │
              │    T                 open the dependency map                         │
              │    C                 open a Claude session on the project            │
              │                                                                      │
              │    Views and filters                                                 │
              │    Tab               the next view                                   │
              │    Shift+Tab         the previous view                               │
              │    /                 filter the list, matching notes too             │
              │    1                 show only blocked items, or every one again     │
              │    2                 show archived items too, or hide them again     │
              │    .                 show or hide shelved and closed projects        │
              │                                                                      │
              │    Everywhere                                                        │
              │    u                 undo the last change                            │
              │    R                 read the data again now                         │
              │    ?                 show these keys                                 │
              │    q Ctrl+c          quit                                            │
              │                                                                      │
              │    [Esc] or [?] Close                                                │
              │                                                                      │
              ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
